responsibility: Implements the concrete RTL patterns for the newer C-SKY FPv3 floating-point unit, including half-precision support and richer fused operations. It defines FPv3 move encodings between general and vector registers, immediate floating literals, arithmetic and fused multiply-add/subtract forms across HF/SF/DF, min/max-style unspec operations, integer/floating conversion instructions with explicit rounding variants, and floating-point control-register access, supplying the target-specific encodings behind the shared FPU expanders.
